user.title: AromaTech Diffuser
user.description: Select your AromaTech diffuser and enter the password (default: 8888)

bluetooth_confirm.title: AromaTech Diffuser
bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name}? Enter the device password (default: 8888).

abort.no_devices_found: No AromaTech devices found. Make sure your diffuser is powered on and in range.
abort.not_supported: This device does not look like an AromaTech diffuser

data_description.health_check_interval: How often to probe the Bluetooth connection (with a silent GATT read) and reconnect if it has died. Set to 0 to disable (recommended unless you see stale connections; advertisements already trigger reconnects).
data_description.time_sync: Write the current time to the device once per Home Assistant session. Only needed if you use schedules configured in the mobile app - and it costs one extra beep per session.
